description: This file contains the implementation of the FooTable plugin's editing component, including class definitions, methods, event handling, and configuration options for editing table rows, such as adding, editing, deleting, and viewing rows, as well as managing the editing column and related UI elements.

classes.name: F.Editing
classes.description: The main class implementing the editing functionality, including UI creation, event handling, and configuration for row editing, adding, deleting, and viewing.

classes.name: F.EditingColumn
classes.description: Represents the editing column in the table, containing buttons for editing, deleting, viewing, and adding rows.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor for the F.Editing class, initializes properties and callbacks based on table options.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies data and options before initializing the editing component.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editing component and generates the UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the editing UI and cleans up event handlers.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the editing UI elements, including buttons and the editing row.

methods.name: $buttonShow
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the show button.

methods.name: $buttonHide
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the hide button.

methods.name: $buttonAdd
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the add button.

methods.name: $buttonEdit
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the edit button.

methods.name: $buttonDelete
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the delete button.

methods.name: $buttonView
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the view button.

methods.name: $rowButtons
methods.description: Creates the button group for row actions.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Adjusts the UI layout based on current options.

methods.name: _onEditClick
methods.description: Event handler for the edit button.

methods.name: _onDeleteClick
methods.description: Event handler for the delete button.

methods.name: _onViewClick
methods.description: Event handler for the view button.

methods.name: _onAddClick
methods.description: Event handler for the add button.

methods.name: _onShowClick
methods.description: Event handler for the show button.

methods.name: _onHideClick
methods.description: Event handler for the hide button.
